description: This file contains the implementation of a validation class for client-side clustering configuration within the Orleans framework. It checks if clustering has been properly configured by ensuring the presence of a gateway list provider service.

classes.name: ClientClusteringValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks whether clustering is properly configured for the Orleans client by verifying the presence of a gateway list provider service.

methods.name: ClientClusteringValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with a service provider.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs the validation check to ensure clustering is configured; throws an exception if not.
